kind: Pluriharmonic transform proof counterchecks and published regularization review
scope: Exact Vigny transform-source display and exceptional-space checks, three direct research proofs, and complete first published Dinh–Sibony regularization/product reading.
mathematical_boundary: The counterchecks and smooth mass lemma are scoped checked proofs. No whole external secondary-tree certificate, general transformation/Siu adoption, new original problem closure or Hermitian product theorem.

primary_version_locators.Vigny: 0711.3782v2 source lines1–420 composite first read; published full text not retrieved.
primary_version_locators.Dinh–Sibony: Published Ann. Sci. Éc. Norm. Sup.37(2004),959–971; all13 page texts and actual images. math/0407532v2 checked in metadata only.

direct_obligations.name: Line normalization
direct_obligations.check: Book kappa restricts to area/pi, giving radius-r line mass r squared.

direct_obligations.name: Annular logarithm
direct_obligations.check: On the punctured line, log|z| squared is harmonic and its ddc is zero.

direct_obligations.name: Printed exponent
direct_obligations.check: The source and actual PDF use r to minus p with actual radius-r balls; p1 gives nonzero left difference and zero right side.

direct_obligations.name: Source conversion
direct_obligations.check: Source ddc is twice book and source log norm is half log norm squared; the line test exactly compares the printed normalization.

direct_obligations.name: Plane separation
direct_obligations.check: The coordinate P2 planes A and B in P5 are smooth and disjoint.

direct_obligations.name: Incidence charts
direct_obligations.check: In the v-nonzero chart the graph resolves blow-up u0; the u-nonzero chart resolves v0, and they cover P5.

direct_obligations.name: Global bundle
direct_obligations.check: Fiber coordinates glue as lines in O(-1,0) directsum O(0,-1), avoiding a claimed global trivial P1 coordinate.

direct_obligations.name: Fiber hyperplane
direct_obligations.check: The birational image of each P1 fiber is a projective line, so h has fiber integral one.

direct_obligations.name: Pushforward L mass
direct_obligations.check: Integration of theta_u squared theta_v squared h equals the normalized base product volume one.

direct_obligations.name: Pushforward Q mass
direct_obligations.check: Birational degree one gives integral h to fifth equals one.

direct_obligations.name: Exceptional section
direct_obligations.check: E_A is t0 and is P2u times P2v; h there comes only from the v factor.

direct_obligations.name: Vanishing Q
direct_obligations.check: h to fourth restricts to zero because the v factor has complex dimension two.

direct_obligations.name: Nonzero L
direct_obligations.check: theta_u squared theta_v squared has integral one on E_A.

direct_obligations.name: Distributional exactness
direct_obligations.check: A smooth closed divisor representative pairs Q-L to minus one; ddc-exact distributions pair to zero by current Stokes.

direct_obligations.name: Ambient qualification
direct_obligations.check: The counterexample concerns forms on E; it does not contradict their equal pushed classes on P5.

direct_obligations.name: Compact proper map
direct_obligations.check: Holomorphic F between compact complex manifolds is proper and pushes closed Omega powers to a closed current.

direct_obligations.name: Bidegree
direct_obligations.check: Gamma=F_*Omega^(N-p) has bidegree n-p on X, complementary to S.

direct_obligations.name: Kahler input
direct_obligations.check: The classical current ddc lemma on compact Kahler X supplies a fixed smooth closed gamma and a distributional primitive.

direct_obligations.name: Legal pairing
direct_obligations.check: S is smooth, so pairing the primitive with ddcS is defined and zero.

direct_obligations.name: Top-degree case
direct_obligations.check: For p=n, Gamma is smooth locally constant on components and no negative-degree primitive is used.

direct_obligations.name: Uniform constant
direct_obligations.check: The fixed smooth gamma pairing is bounded by positive-current trace mass, independently of S.

direct_obligations.name: No exterior hypothesis
direct_obligations.check: No exterior derivative of S is used in the mass estimate; positive ddc-closed smooth S suffices.

direct_obligations.name: Matrix dimension
direct_obligations.check: The PDF9 push under hat-pi1 has relative dimension k and cannot send a k-1 form to the stated k-1 target; the needed off-fiber pullback identity remains meaningful.

direct_obligations.name: Whole-line harmonicity
direct_obligations.check: Positive harmonic scalar functions on the entire complex line are constant; the local bidisc example at457 avoids that premise.

direct_obligations.name: Regularization statement
direct_obligations.check: Actual published Theorem4.1 p965 gives positive smooth ddc-closed differences and uniform mass on compact Kahler manifolds.

direct_obligations.name: Support dependency
direct_obligations.check: Its exact hypersurface support reference is Bassanelli1994; no full older support/extension proof certification is inferred.

direct_obligations.name: Continuous potential scope
direct_obligations.check: Published Theorem5.1 and energy estimate apply to continuous scalar potentials, not arbitrary L1 form primitives.

direct_obligations.name: Published display degree
direct_obligations.check: Prop5.5 p970 uses a 1,1-current and test1-form with omega^(k-1), which exceeds top degree and needs k-2; no bounded-potential branch is adopted.

direct_obligations.name: Exact source levels
direct_obligations.check: Vigny source first read is composite1-420; DS all13 page texts/images are actual first reads; neither complete automatic second proof read is asserted.
